q1.sampleAnswer: Because they have a special kind of genes.

keyPoints.descZh: 因为他们有特殊的基因
examples: They have a special kind of genes.

q1.explanationZh: 第一段说，有些人睡得少是因为他们的基因。

evidence.quote: This is because of their genes

q2.sampleAnswer: Natural short sleepers are people with a special gene who only need four to six hours of sleep each night.

keyPoints.descZh: 有特殊基因、每晚只需睡四到六小时的人
examples: People with a special gene who sleep only four to six hours each night.

q2.rubricZh: 要点：特殊基因 + 每晚只睡4–6小时（答出身份即可酌情给分）。
q2.explanationZh: 第二段告诉我们：有这种特殊基因的人叫 NSS，他们每晚通常只睡四到六小时。

evidence.quote: People with this special gene are called natural short sleepers (NSS).

q3.sampleAnswer: Because when we sleep, our brains sort out what we learned, fix memories, and help our bodies rest and grow.

keyPoints.descZh: 睡觉时大脑梳理所学、巩固记忆，身体休息和成长
examples: Our brains sort out what we learned, fix memories, and help our bodies rest and grow.

q3.rubricZh: 要点：睡觉时大脑整理所学、修复记忆，身体休息成长。
q3.explanationZh: 第三段说，睡觉时大脑会整理学过的东西、巩固记忆，身体也能休息和长大，所以睡眠很重要。

evidence.quote: When we sleep, our brains sort out

q4.sampleAnswer: They feel happy and ready for the day.

examples: They feel happy and ready for the day.

q4.rubricZh: 要点：happy and ready for the day。
q4.explanationZh: 第二段说，他们醒来时感觉很开心，已经准备好迎接新的一天。

evidence.quote: they feel happy and ready for the day

q5.sampleAnswer: Their brains can work at a higher level.

examples: Their brains work at a higher level.

q5.rubricZh: 要点：大脑工作水平更高。
q5.explanationZh: 最后一段说，科学家觉得他们的大脑“在更高的水平上工作”，做事更快。

evidence.quote: their brains “work at a higher level”
